# **How to read this document**

Every observation has an ID (for example WEB-03) so it can be discussed and tracked easily. Each item shows where the problem is, what the tester noted, what we expect, and space for the development team’s response. The tester’s original notes are kept word for word; the “Expected result” lines were added to make each request clear.

| Code | Section | What it covers |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| WEB | 1\. Public website | Problems visitors see on the website |
| DON | 2\. Donation page | Donate page design, rules and donor features |
| ADM | 3\. Admin panel | Problems and requests in the CMS used by MESCO staff |
| NEW | 4\. New pages and features | Things to be added |
| UI | 5\. Design, text and content | Formatting, wording, phone numbers, icons |
| BRD | 6\. BRD gap list | Requirements from the BRD that are missing or incomplete |

### **Labels used**

| Label | Meaning |
| :---- | :---- |
| Bug | Something is broken or does not work as it should |
| Change | Works, but needs to be changed as requested |
| Design / Content | Look, formatting or wording needs correcting |
| New feature | Something new to be built |
| Question | The development team needs to confirm how it works |
| High / Medium / Low | Suggested priority; MESCO may change these |

# **6\. BRD gap list**

*Requirements from the Business Requirement Document (MESCO Website Requirement Proposal, V5) that are missing or only partly done on the demo website.*

## **A. Missing completely (required in the BRD)**

| \# | BRD section | BRD point | What the website has |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Integration | Google Analytics | Not installed. The site’s security policy would also block it from loading. |
| 2 | Push Notifications | Browser push alerts for events, campaigns and announcements, managed from admin | Nothing, on the site or in the admin panel |
| 3 | SEO | FAQ schema | Missing, and there’s no FAQ page |
| 4 | SEO | Breadcrumb schema | Visible breadcrumbs exist, but not the schema search engines read |
| 5 | Home Page | Photo Gallery | Shows “No gallery images are available”, even though the gallery page has 23 albums |
| 6 | About Us | Our Founding Story | No page, only a one-line mention |
| 7 | About Us | Milestones timeline | Missing create this page for us |
| 8 | Our Work | Campaigns (create/join fundraising for causes) | No page and no module (/campaigns shows “Page not found”) |
| 9 | Get Involved \> Volunteer | SPOC / department contact details | Missing on the Volunteer page |
| 10 | Contact Us | Department contacts (Donations, Scholarships, Volunteering) | Only the general email and phone numbers |
| 11 | Footer | Feedback option or form | Missing |

## **B. Partly done (something missing)**

| \# | BRD point | What’s missing |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 12 | Advanced search across pages, events, news and annual reports | Search matches page titles only, with no events, blogs, news or report PDFs. “scholarship” and “zakat” return nothing. |
| 13 | Mission & Vision | Only a section inside “MESCO At Glance”, with no separate page |
| 14 | Our Team (Leadership, Volunteers, Advisors) | Staff and committee are listed, but there are no volunteers or advisors |
| 15 | Testimonials under About Us | Only under Impact |
| 16 | Work/Career (jobs and internships) | Jobs are listed, internships are not |
| 17 | Mobile responsiveness | The home banner text and buttons are invisible on mobile at first load |
| 18 | Security (XSS safeguards) | Found in the earlier test: a blog title or event location can inject HTML into public pages |

## **C. Optional (“good to have”) points, none built**

| \# | Point |
| :---- | :---- |
| 19 | Donor login, donation history, receipt download and profile management. |
| 20 | E-receipt access on the website. |
| 21 | Alumni registration, alumni search by country, batch or profession, community and job posts, meetup tools, and alumni content sharing. |
| 22 | Admin-side settings: push-notification and analytics settings and receipt email templates. These could not be confirmed during the admin re-check; the development team should confirm whether they exist. |
| 23 | The admin panel should have one overall search bar to search from the full admin panel. |

# **Appendix A. Additional findings from QA testing**

*Added for completeness: important findings from the earlier full QA test of the website and admin panel that are not already covered above.*

| \# | Area | Severity | Finding |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| A1 | Security | Critical | Text such as \</script\> in a blog title or event location breaks out of the page’s structured data and injects HTML into the public page (same as BRD item 18). Fix before go-live. |
| A2 | Permissions | High | An Author can edit and publish any blog or event, including ones created by Admin, with no review step. |
| A3 | Content | High | Dummy (lorem ipsum) content is live: the only event, the blog post, one donor testimonial, the first In Media clipping and the chatbot entry “hyperlink test”. |
| A4 | Content | Medium | The Awards & Recognition page shows 6 identical “Credibility Alliance” cards instead of MESCO’s real awards. |
| A5 | Admin | Medium | No warning when leaving an unsaved page or blog; changes are lost. Saving an empty new page creates an “Untitled” page. |
| A6 | Social media | Medium | Instagram on the Social Wall cannot connect (saved credentials cannot be decrypted); last sync 16 Jul 2026\. |
| A7 | SEO | Medium | Missing pages return a normal (HTTP 200\) response instead of a 404 error, which can affect search ranking. |
| A8 | Donate | Medium | For new donors, Zakat and Interest Money both default to “Yes”, and PAN is mandatory (the BRD says optional). |
